purpose: Test learned whole-chain adjustment with separate motif/scaffold noise clocks after fixed-scaffold repair failed. This is a new path and objective, not an extension of the failed repair checkpoint.
model: Start again from the unchanged 6000-update generator and isolated geometry/token adapter. Add a zero-output 2-to-256-to-width token adapter for each residue clock offset alpha and alpha*(1-t). Gate its output by alpha. Freeze unused sequence/pair parameters and the original codec. Train the remaining trunk and fragment/clock adapters. No clean native scaffold context is supplied to the network.
path: For each protein draw scaffold alpha=0 or 0.5 with equal probability. Motif plus eight flanking residues always have alpha=0. At global time t, local time tau=alpha+(1-alpha)*t; x=(1-tau)*epsilon+tau*z_native. Learn unscaled velocity z_native-epsilon at every real residue. Integrate dx/dt=(1-alpha)*v. Endpoint self-conditioning is x+(1-tau)*v. No residue is clamped or copied at intermediate steps or after normalization.
objective: Logit-normal global times, 10% fragment dropout, inherited 50% self-conditioning. Conditional examples give the motif-plus-flanks window and remaining scaffold equal loss mass; dropout examples use uniform residue loss. All 512 original training proteins, uniformly sampled within cycled length buckets, with three separately encoded 20-residue motifs. No training on generated/native paired repairs; generated scaffold distribution shift remains a limitation.
sampling: Start motif window from the original fixed repair Gaussian; start remaining scaffold at 0.5*context+0.5*noise. Run 50 Euler steps and terminal per-residue normalization on the entire chain. Context is either the archived parent generated latent or an explicitly labelled native oracle. It is never re-injected. Reuse original four AE3 decoder noises. Four repaired arms: generated/native context crossed with fragment on/off. No raw acceptance filter, extra attempts, guidance or oracle mixtures.
optimizer: FP32 with activation checkpointing. AdamW betas(.9,.95), weight decay .01, clip 1. Trunk LR1e-5; fragment and clock adapters LR3e-4; 40-update warmup and cosine to .1 floor over 2000; EMA .99; final checkpoint only. One seed pilot, no schedule/start-time/window/learning-rate sweep.
controls: Initialization with alpha=0 must reproduce all 16 archived parent latents from one protein per length bucket at <=1e-5. Initial alpha=.5 generated conditioned outputs on the entire evaluation panel form an untrained-path control. Parent and direct native decodes must reproduce historical motif/validity decisions, CA RMSD<=.2A and lDDT>=.99. Supplied fragment coordinate rotations/translations must change final latents <=1e-4. Saved EMA reload GPU replay <=1e-5. Independently audit all outputs, unchanged codec/unused weights, finite gradients and nonzero parameter updates. Profile/full first 40 draws and raw/EMA weights must match (weights <=1e-4).
profile: One 40-update RTX profile with 25-minute allocation. Four proteins, four noises, all four arms. Profile gates concern numerical correctness and peak<=75GiB, not quality. Derive full allocation from measured training/evaluation time with headroom. No full submission until independent profile audit passes.
evaluation: All 32 original repeatedly used training-diagnostic proteins and four noises: 128 outputs per arm, no selection. Native-context performance is oracle capacity, not a generated success. Report whole/fixed-region coordinate displacement, not a fixed-scaffold invariant. Family-bootstrap paired differences against parent, null and initial untrained path. Any failed full gate closes this fixed pilot; retain every failure. No claim of initialization-only or scaffold-compatibility causation because path, conditioning and objective change together.
refolding: Only after all full gates pass: all128 generated-conditioned and all128 generated-null backbones, eight fixed-motif CA-only ProteinMPNN designs each, deterministic FP32 refolding with3loops/50steps. Reuse original parent/native budgets without pooling attempts. In the SAME valid refold require motif proper CA RMSD<=1A and dRMS<=1A, global TM>.5 and scaffold TM>.5. Advancement requires >8 strong outputs, >=7 successful families and >=45 designable outputs, with protein bootstrap intervals. Report all-pair and jointly successful diversity, and incremental and end-to-end compute. Passing this training diagnostic requires a later fresh development cohort before any generalization claim; locked tests remain untouched.
resources: One RTX at a time for profile and training; at most8 registered running-plus-pending project GPUs globally. Exact own-job monitoring and completion audits. No refolds before gates pass. No study submissions until trainer/auditor and watcher action are implemented and tested.
